name: finish_after_long_reconnect_gap
description: SCA-4385 variant, synthetic. The incident's capture without the sync fragment, and with a 360 s stream gap between A (0-64 s) and B (424-449 s), longer than the ordinary 300 s silence gap: only the reconnect rule (same origin and device, new session) joins A and B. A seals at 404 s, when listen gives up on the lost stream. The user taps Finish at 447 s; B's fast-finish transcript lands at 464 s and A's batch transcript at 479 s. The Finish conversation should hold A and B and be visible on Home.

expected_failure.reason: SCA-4385: on origin/main a manual-end cut does not wait for its capture's pending batch transcript (review of #26304). The planner fix (lane v3-finish-late-predecessor) should flip this to a pass and delete this block.
